summary: PayPay Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its acquisition of 70.2% of T D Financial Life Insurance from T D Holdings for cash, funded from cash on hand. OneIM intends to acquire 14.9% separately, with no joint voting arrangement. Post-closing, PayPay gets a call option on T D Holdings' remaining 14.9% stake, with a put option exercisable after three years. The deal is subject to regulatory approvals, IFRS transition, and other conditions. The consideration price per share and total value are not stated. The board of PayPay resolved to proceed; no advisor named. What to watch: regulatory clearance, IFRS implementation timeline, and any risk-arb spread if terms emerge.
